textos_alternativos: Cover: Rio New Year's Eve, what it costs. Fireworks over Copacabana beach
Dec 31 in Copacabana: free beach party, main stage from 6 pm, 12 minutes of fireworks from 19 barges, 13 stages across Rio
Getting there: last year's metro round trip cost R$ 15, about US$ 2.55, sold online only; Avenida Atlântica closed; no cars after 9 pm
Four tips: wear white, carry little, pick a meeting point, Leme and Posto 6 are less crowded
Bonus: free Christmas samba show on Dec 26 on the Copacabana main stage
